title: WPSS/442/2015 of Aman Deep Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 442 of 2015
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
None turns up on behalf of the
petitioner.
Mr. BPS Mer, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand/respondent nos. 1
and 2.
Application for withdrawal has
been moved by the petitioner. Paragraph
no.3 of the said application states that
the petitionerís grievance has been
redressed; therefore, he does not want
to press the present writ petition.
Application for withdrawal (CLMA
No.4619 of 2015) is hereby allowed.
Accordingly, instant writ petition
is dismissed as not pressed.
